tldr_zh: OpenAI融資政策創新，Anthropic營收激增至65B美元，AI芯片與安全漏洞成科技焦點。
tldr_en: OpenAI funds AI policy projects while Anthropic's annualized revenue surges to $65B; security vulnerabilities and chip innovations dominate tech landscape.

items.title_zh: Anthropic年度營收暴增至650億美元，AI模型商業化加速
items.title_en: Anthropic's annualized revenue surges to $65 billion
items.summary_zh: Anthropic在兩個月內增加了180億美元的年度營收，達到650億美元。這一快速增長反映出AI模型提供商商業化加速，客戶對高性能語言模型的需求強勁。此成績標誌著AI產業競爭進入新階段，Anthropic與OpenAI等主要廠商展開激烈較量。
items.summary_en: Anthropic added $18 billion in annualized revenue in just two months, reaching $65 billion total. The rapid growth demonstrates accelerating commercialization of AI models and strong customer demand for high-performance language models. This achievement marks Anthropic's emergence as a major competitor alongside OpenAI in the intensifying AI market.

items.title_zh: OpenAI資助14個AI政策研究項目，探索智能時代治理框架
items.title_en: OpenAI funds 14 independent AI policy research projects
items.summary_zh: OpenAI宣布資助14個獨立項目探索AI時代的新政策想法，旨在擴大經濟機會並強化社會韌性。這反映科技公司對AI監管框架發展的主動參與，涉及政策創新、經濟影響評估等關鍵領域。
items.summary_en: OpenAI announced funding for 14 independent projects exploring new policy ideas for the Intelligence Age, aiming to expand economic opportunity and strengthen societal resilience. This demonstrates proactive industry engagement in developing AI governance frameworks across critical policy domains.

items.title_zh: DeepSeek開源AI代理執行框架Harness，支援外掛模組化設計
items.title_en: DeepSeek opens DeepSeek Harness AI agent framework with modular plugin architecture
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek開源AI代理執行框架DeepSeek Harness，採用Cordis外掛系統，讓開發者可自由組合模型、工具、技能等組件，無需修改原始碼。此舉推進AI代理應用的開發民主化，降低開發門檻。
items.summary_en: DeepSeek open-sourced its AI agent execution framework with a modular plugin architecture enabling developers to freely combine models, tools, and skills without modifying source code. This democratizes AI agent application development and lowers barriers for developers.

items.title_zh: 蘋果用戶收到創紀錄數量間諜軟體警報，安全專家稱前所未有
items.title_en: Unprecedented number of Apple users received spyware alerts from Apple
items.summary_zh: 網安研究人員表示，最近收到蘋果威脅通知的用戶數量異常龐大。蘋果針對特定威脅向用戶發送警示，顯示其檢測到大規模監視威脅。此事突顯蘋果用戶面臨的日益複雜的安全威脅環境。
items.summary_en: Cybersecurity experts report an unusually high number of users received recent threat notifications from Apple. The unprecedented scale of alerts indicates Apple detected widespread surveillance threats targeting its users, highlighting increasingly complex security challenges facing the platform.

items.title_zh: YouTube改變播放次數計算方式，8月24日起單次播放即算數
items.title_en: YouTube changes view counting to match Instagram, TikTok standards
items.summary_zh: YouTube宣布將於8月24日起改變播放次數的計算方式，改為影片開始播放時即計為一次播放，與Instagram和TikTok標準一致。此舉將使創作者的播放次數增長更快，改變平臺績效衡量標準。
items.summary_en: YouTube announced it will change view counting on August 24 to count a view when video playback starts, aligning with Instagram and TikTok standards. This change will accelerate view count growth for creators and shift performance metrics on the platform.

items.title_zh: Reddit開始測試AI語音影片功能，將文章轉換為短影片
items.title_en: Reddit tests AI-powered audio and video conversion of text posts
items.summary_zh: Reddit開始測試將文字貼文轉換為AI語音和影片的功能，類似TikTok短影片形式。系統利用AI語音朗讀原文和留言，旨在為用戶提供多元內容消費方式。此舉反映社群媒體追求視覺化、短影片的產業趨勢。
items.summary_en: Reddit is testing features that convert text posts into AI-narrated audio and video content, similar to TikTok format. The system uses AI voices to read posts and comments, offering users multiple content consumption methods. This reflects the industry trend toward visual and short-form content.

items.title_zh: Google Chrome團隊收購AI自動化新創Relay，關閉獨立運營
items.title_en: Google's Chrome team acquires AI automation startup Relay
items.summary_zh: AI自動化新創Relay宣布關閉，其員工加入Google Chrome團隊。創辦人Bank表示將在Chrome中推出更多AI輔助工作功能。此次收購顯示Google在瀏覽器層整合AI自動化功能的戰略。
items.summary_en: AI automation startup Relay announced shutdown with its staff joining Google's Chrome team. Founder Jacob Bank indicated ambitious plans to add AI-powered work assistance features in Chrome. This acquisition reflects Google's strategy to integrate AI automation at the browser level.

items.title_zh: Higgsfield融資4億美元估值衝破54億，AI影片生成軟體受熱捧
items.title_en: Higgsfield raises $400M Series B at $5.4B valuation
items.summary_zh: AI影片生成平臺Higgsfield完成4億美元B輪融資，估值達54億美元，8個月內估值翻倍。前Snap高管創辦的公司因AI影像和影片生成能力獲投資者青睞，反映生成式AI應用市場的火熱。
items.summary_en: AI video generation platform Higgsfield raised $400 million in Series B, reaching $5.4 billion valuation—doubling in 8 months. Founded by former Snap exec, the company's success reflects strong investor interest in generative AI applications for content creation.

items.title_zh: 竹科地政導入AI協審，半年處理逾2000件登記案件省時超3萬分鐘
items.title_en: Taiwan's Hsinchu Land Office uses AI to process over 2,000 cases in 6 months
items.summary_zh: 新竹市地政事務所導入AI輔助審查系統，半年內處理逾2000件不動產登記案件，節省超過3萬分鐘工時。系統可自動核對95個欄位，解決少子化下公務人力不足問題，為政府AI應用典範。
items.summary_en: Hsinchu Land Office deployed AI-assisted review system to process over 2,000 property registration cases in 6 months, saving over 30,000 minutes of work. The system automates verification of 95 data fields, addressing labor shortage challenges—a key government AI success story.

items.title_zh: Rancher爆高危權限提升漏洞CVE-2026-44945，評分9.1屬重大風險
items.title_en: Critical privilege escalation vulnerability in Kubernetes platform Rancher
items.summary_zh: SUSE揭露Kubernetes多叢集管理平臺Rancher重大漏洞CVE-2026-44945，CVSS評分9.1。攻擊者只需控制一個下游叢集即可冒充身分，取得全部Rancher管理權。此漏洞威脅企業級Kubernetes環境安全。
items.summary_en: SUSE disclosed critical privilege escalation vulnerability in Rancher with CVSS 9.1 score. Attackers controlling one downstream cluster can impersonate identities and gain complete Rancher control. This threatens enterprise Kubernetes environments globally.

items.title_zh: 川普威脅轟炸盟國阿曼，60天伊朗談判期屆滿雙方分歧未解
items.title_en: Trump threatens to bomb ally Oman over Iran negotiations as deadline expires
items.summary_zh: 川普威脅若阿曼在伊朗問題上「擋路」將轟炸該國。阿曼一直與伊朗談判重啟荷莫茲海峽，60天談判期已屆滿但雙方立場相距甚遠。川普表示不尋求延長與伊朗的諒解備忘錄。
items.summary_en: Trump threatened to bomb ally Oman if it 'gets in the way' over Iran negotiations. The 60-day peace negotiation window expires with the two sides still far apart. Trump indicated he won't seek extension of the Iran memorandum of understanding.

items.title_zh: 習近平9月訪美與川普會談，無意參加聯合國大會
items.title_en: Xi Jinping to visit US in September for talks with Trump, skipping UN General Assembly
items.summary_zh: 據美國政治新聞媒體Politico報導，中國主席習近平9月訪美將與川普在華府會面，但無意前往紐約參加聯合國大會發表演說。此訪問標誌美中關係重要對話機制的啟動。
items.summary_en: Politico reports Chinese President Xi Jinping will visit the US in September for talks with Trump in Washington but won't attend the UN General Assembly in New York. This visit marks an important dialogue mechanism between the US and China.
